description:
The cost graph prices calls by the context tier their prompt lands in. The model catalog and pricing are mocked: the model bills 5x once a call's prompt exceeds 100k tokens. The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} serves usage for two calls, one below and one above the threshold. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new.
2. Wait (with an eval that has expect) until JSON.stringify(window.__SHELLEY_INIT__?.models) is exactly {{MODELS}}: the page loaded the mocked model catalog.
3. Navigate client-side, in one eval: history.pushState({}, "", "/c/{{SLUG}}"); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent("popstate")). Do NOT use a navigate step here: the page must not reload.
4. Click the VISIBLE ".context-usage-label" element (a hidden one may exist too; pick the visible one). "The popup" is the ".chat-context-popup" element.
5. The popup's ".token-cost-graph-svg" element is visible.
6. The popup's [data-testid="token-cost-total"] text contains "≈$0.111" (at the base rate throughout it would be only $0.031).
7. The calls straddle the threshold, so each band was served at two rates: the first ".token-cost-legend-unit" element in the popup whose text contains "mixed rates" is visible.
